sUCtD3p6bEGsSE7v1gxKeg.zh: 伊拉克北部庫德斯坦地區報告2例確定病例,均為屠夫,其中1例為43歲,住院觀察且病情穩定,另1例為自外地移入,當局已啟動工作隊於豢養牲畜之地區進行大規模農藥噴灑作業。該國今(2025)年迄今累計報告231例,其中36例死亡,病例主要集中於濟加爾省(37%)、巴達省(12%)、穆薩納省(8.6%)和瓦西特省(8.2%)。
sUCtD3p6bEGsSE7v1gxKeg.en: In the Kurdistan Region of northern Iraq, two confirmed cases were reported, both butchers. One patient, aged 43, is hospitalized under observation and is stable. The other case was imported from another area. Authorities have launched a team to carry out large-scale pesticide spraying in areas where livestock are kept. So far this year, Iraq has cumulatively reported 231 cases, of which 36 died. Cases are mainly concentrated in Dhi Qar (37%), Badra (12%), Muthanna (8.6%) and Wasit (8.2%) governorates.

qnZo0A1fw0AnfN13p0SUCw.zh: 伊拉克疫情更新,今(2025)年迄今累計報告231例,其中30例死亡,以該國南部濟加爾省(Dhi Qar)84例為多,其次為中部巴達省(Baghdad)38例,當局呼籲民眾於可信賴管道購買肉品、冷凍儲存肉品並於食用前高溫煮熟。該國最大疫情發生在2023年,報告逾587 例病例及83例死亡,主要影響南部省份。
qnZo0A1fw0AnfN13p0SUCw.en: Iraq's epidemic update: so far in 2025, 231 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 30 deaths. Dhi Qar Province in the south accounts for the most, with 84 cases, followed by Baghdad Province in central Iraq with 38 cases. Authorities urge people to buy meat from trusted sources, freeze meat for storage, and cook it thoroughly before eating. Iraq's largest outbreak occurred in 2023, with more than 587 cases and 83 deaths, mainly affecting southern provinces.

iHfkcJwuLq3YwI-4-Ybh4w.zh: 希臘北部色薩利大區報告1例死亡病例,為72歲畜牧農民,病情急速惡化,並於住院後死亡,匡列接觸者25人均未出現症狀。本案為該國自2008年以來第2例,當局呼籲高風險族群應採取個人防護措施,以預防蜱蟲叮咬。 伊拉克疫情更新,今(2025)年迄今報告179例,其中23例死亡,以該國南部濟加爾省(Dhi Qar)50例為多,其次為中部巴達省(Baghdad)28例,感染歸因於不安全的肉類處理和不受監管的屠宰行為,當局呼籲民眾於可信賴管道購買肉品,並於食用前冷凍肉品。
iHfkcJwuLq3YwI-4-Ybh4w.en: The Thessaly region in northern Greece reported one death, a 72-year-old livestock farmer whose condition deteriorated rapidly and who died after admission to hospital. All 25 contacts identified have remained asymptomatic. This is the second case in the country since 2008. Authorities urge high-risk groups to take personal protective measures to prevent tick bites. Iraq's update: so far in 2025, 179 cases have been reported, including 23 deaths, with 50 cases in Dhi Qar Province in the south and 28 in Baghdad Province in the centre. Infections are attributed to unsafe meat handling and unregulated slaughter. Authorities urge people to buy meat from trusted sources and to freeze meat before eating.

6LTLUuWxJ8cLyDrqduq_Nw.zh: 伊拉克疫情更新,今年迄今報告125例,其中21例死亡,以該國南部濟加爾省(Dhi Qar)36例為多,病患多數為牲畜相關業者,該國規劃針對非法放牧、屠宰及牲畜販運採取更嚴的管制。 喬治亞南部薩姆茨赫-賈瓦赫蒂區今年迄今報告3例,其中2例死亡,該區人類感染病例占全國80%以上,該國已針對該區大型牲畜場域進行殺蟎劑處理,以減少蜱蟲數量。
6LTLUuWxJ8cLyDrqduq_Nw.en: Iraq's update: so far this year, 125 cases have been reported, including 21 deaths, with 36 cases in Dhi Qar Province in the south. Most patients are livestock-related workers. Iraq plans stricter controls on illegal grazing, slaughter and livestock trafficking. Georgia: in the Samtskhe–Javakheti region in the south, 3 cases have been reported so far this year, 2 of them fatal. This region accounts for more than 80% of human cases nationally. The country has applied acaricide treatment to large livestock areas in the region to reduce tick numbers.

Eb1RsoVGe0UgvYsm3D6RaQ.zh: 伊拉克疫情更新,今年迄今共9省報告27例,其中7例死亡,病例以該國南部濟加爾省(Dhi Qar)8例為多,其次為穆薩納省(Muthanna)7例及北部基爾庫克省(Kirkuk) 6例。當局呼籲屠宰業者於屠宰前應進行清消,並於合法地點進行相關作業;民眾於可信賴管道購買肉品,並徹底煮熟肉類等。
Eb1RsoVGe0UgvYsm3D6RaQ.en: Iraq update: so far this year, 27 cases have been reported across 9 provinces, 7 of them fatal. Cases are most numerous in Dhi Qar Province in the south (8), followed by Muthanna Province (7) and Kirkuk Province in the north (6). Authorities urge slaughterhouse operators to disinfect before slaughter and to carry out slaughter only at legal sites. The public is advised to buy meat from trusted sources and to cook meat thoroughly.

gqyY-uhaC3c2HPSL5TTmag.zh: 伊拉克今年迄今共8省報告19例,其中2例死亡,病例以該國南部濟加爾省(Dhi Qar)7例為多,其次為北部基爾庫克省(Kirkuk) 4例,部分地區關閉無照屠宰場,當局加強店家及屠宰場檢查,另薩拉丁省宣佈進入公共衛生緊急狀態。
gqyY-uhaC3c2HPSL5TTmag.en: Iraq has reported 19 cases in 8 provinces so far this year, 2 of them fatal. Cases were mostly in Dhi Qar Province in the south (7), followed by Kirkuk Province in the north (4). Some areas have closed unlicensed slaughterhouses, and authorities have strengthened inspections of shops and slaughterhouses. Salah al-Din Province has declared a public health emergency.

gEC8IyTtywgI6xiOokCqDw.zh: 伊拉克南部濟加爾省於3/2報告新增今年首例病例,病患為40歲男性個案,當局已封鎖該區並進行消毒。另該國於2024年全年累計211例病例,其中,26例死亡(CFR:12%),病例以濟加爾省為多。
gEC8IyTtywgI6xiOokCqDw.en: Dhi Qar Province in southern Iraq reported its first case of the year on 2 March: a 40-year-old man. Authorities have cordoned off the area and carried out disinfection. The country recorded 211 cases cumulatively in 2024, of which 26 died (CFR: 12%); cases were concentrated in Dhi Qar Province.
